resolvedStack: React Native / Expo SDK 52 + Expo Router + TypeScript + AsyncStorage
name: FieldPulse Site Inspector
description: FieldPulse Site Inspector is an offline-first Expo React Native mobile application for construction site engineers to complete safety checklists, log structural defects, track active site alerts, and persist field inspection reports locally with AsyncStorage.

metadata.name: FieldPulse Site Inspector
metadata.description: Offline-first Expo SDK 52 mobile app for construction site inspections, defect logs, and safety checklists.

files.description: Expo SDK 52, expo-router, react-native-web, react-native-safe-area-context, @expo/vector-icons, and @react-native-async-storage/async-storage configuration.
Expo configuration with Metro web bundler, expo-router plugin, and scheme.
TypeScript configuration extending expo/tsconfig.base with @/* path alias.
Semantic design tokens (colors, spacing, radius, typography) for FieldPulse mobile UI.
Expo Router Web HTML document shell embedding the Axiom Live Edit inspector.
Expo Router root Stack layout wrapped in SafeAreaProvider.
Expo Router bottom tab navigator layout for index, inspections, defects, and settings.

Shared TypeScript types and interfaces: InspectionStatus ('PASS' | 'ACTION_REQUIRED' | 'PENDING'), SeverityLevel ('CRITICAL' | 'MAJOR' | 'MINOR'), ChecklistItem { id, label, passed }, SiteInspection { id, siteName, zone, inspector, status, updatedAt, checklist }, DefectItem { id, title, zone, severity, resolved, reportedAt, notes }.

Offline-first React hook/store persisting SiteInspection[] and DefectItem[] to @react-native-async-storage/async-storage with realistic construction seed data and CRUD actions: addInspection, toggleChecklistItem, addDefect, toggleDefectResolved, resetDemoData, plus computed stats (passRate, openDefects, activeSites).
Reusable React Native badge pill rendering InspectionStatus or SeverityLevel with StyleSheet.create and theme tokens from '@/theme'.
Reusable React Native Pressable card showing construction site name, zone, inspector, checklist completion ratio bar, StatusPill, and onPress handler styled with StyleSheet.create and '@/theme'.

Home dashboard mobile screen wrapped in SafeAreaView (react-native-safe-area-context) and ScrollView, displaying KPI summary cards (Active Sites, Open Defects, Pass Rate), active safety alert banner, recent InspectionCard items, and quick navigation buttons via expo-router.

Site inspections checklist screen with status filter chips (All, PASS, ACTION_REQUIRED, PENDING), interactive checklist item toggles, InspectionCard list, and an interactive form/modal to add a new inspection.
Structural defect tracker screen with severity filter chips (All, CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR), Pressable toggle to resolve/reopen defects, and a form to report a new defect.
Inspector profile & offline storage settings screen displaying inspector metadata, AsyncStorage sync stats, and a Pressable button to reset demo seed data.
